instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct spelling of the word.

atoms.b: This shop has a money-back ((++guarantee garantee gurantee garruntee)).
atoms.finishSound: This shop has a money-back guarantee.

atoms.b: He is being a ((++hindrance handrance hindrense hundrance)) today.
atoms.finishSound: He is being a hindrance today.

atoms.b: ((++According Ackording Acarding Acurdding)) to the law, he did nothing wrong.
atoms.finishSound: According to the law, he did nothing wrong.

atoms.b: Don’t let work ((++interfere intrafere intaferr innterfur)) with your social life.
atoms.finishSound: Don’t let work interfere with your social life.

atoms.b: They say that ((++curiosity currsity cariasity currosety)) killed the cat.
atoms.finishSound: They say that curiosity killed the cat.

atoms.b: ((++Lightning Liggtning Laghtning Litening)) looks like a jagged zigzag.
atoms.finishSound: Lightning looks like a jagged zigzag.

atoms.b: The dinner was ((++excellent ecksellent exallent eccullent)).
